## Improved
- Play on: while you control another device, everything you play goes there: songs and videos from any list, search, album, radio or the queue, plus play, pause, skip, seek and queue edits. Only bringing playback back to this device plays it here again (#1412)
- Play on: while you control another device that plays music, the music player shows its song, queue and progress (#1412)

## Fixed
- Play on: songs and videos after the first one in a queue another device hands over now show their titles and artists (#1412)
